correctness.rationale: PASS: With omitted vertices W, each edge internal to G[W] is forced; other essential selected edges are exactly one cross-edge from each w isolated in G[W]. Selected receivers u are essential iff an unchosen edge u-w to W becomes uncovered upon removal; bad receiver events require all nonempty W-neighbors isolated in G[W] and all assigned to u. Inclusion–exclusion over pairwise disjoint receiver neighbor sets B_u gives c_G(W); each minimal cover has weight n-|W|+e(W)+|I(W)|. Bound at most sum_W 2^{n-|W|}=3^n terms. Independent original-coverage brute force matched receiver formula for K2, P3, K3, C4, K4. n=1 isolated-vertex boundary yields only its chosen vertex.
